name: perfo
description: Perfo - he thong dat ve rap phim (backend .NET + frontend React). Moi lenh dev/build/test/db/docker chay tu thu muc goc.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:tools && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check: npm run format:backend:check && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.docker:exec:db: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d CinemaDb
scripts.db:migration:add: dotnet ef migrations add --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:migration:remove: dotnet ef migrations remove --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:migration:list: dotnet ef migrations list --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:migration:script: dotnet ef migrations script --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api --idempotent --output backend/migration.sql
scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.db:drop: dotnet ef database drop --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api --force
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:drop && npm run db:update
scripts.db:info: dotnet ef dbcontext info --project backend/Cinema.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/Cinema.Api
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:load: npm run test:load:browse && npm run test:load:peak
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:load
